claim: Per-user limit counts requests only (600/min commands). No byte/row cap or retention: record_row_history copies whole old row on every UPDATE; ~100kb config/program/library docs accepted per save (local: validateSaveConfig kept 100816 of 100868 bytes); refuse() stores up to 100kb payload per refusal in refused_writes; log_entries/library_items/list_items unlimited distinct client_ids; app role has no DELETE grant. One free Google account could add ~60MB/min of history to shared Neon.
notes: Blockers: Neon plan storage ceiling; Postgres needed to measure growth.
